product_brief: A hardware-accelerated cryptographic library implementing quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms and primitives through dedicated hardware modules.
pqc_capability_description: Implements quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms and primitives through dedicated hardware modules. Validated algorithms include ML-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer), ML-KEM (EncapDecap, KeyGen), and SLH-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer).
crypto_primitives: ML-DSA, ML-KEM, SLH-DSA, SHA3-224, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512, SHAKE-128, SHAKE-256, Counter DRBG

product_brief: A C90 library supporting the ML-DSA / FIPS 204 post-quantum cryptography standard with minimal performance and maintenance cost.
pqc_capability_description: v1.0.0-alpha release of a C90 library for ML-DSA / FIPS 204. Designed for production deployments with minimal dependencies. Includes native backends for AArch64 and x86-64. Memory safety, type safety, and timing leakage are checked via static model checking (CBMC) and dynamic instrumentation (valgrind).
architecture_type: Library with native backends for AArch64 and x86-64
fips_validated: No (Supports FIPS 204 standard, but validation status not stated)
regulatory_status: Supported by the Linux Foundation and Post-Quantum Cryptography Alliance
pqc_roadmap_details: External APIs are expected but not guaranteed to be stable.
implementation_attack_surface: Absence of various classes of timing leakage is automatically checked. Memory safety and type safety are checked.
testing_&_validation_methods: Static model checking (CBMC) and dynamic instrumentation (valgrind) used on every change.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Minimal and configurable dependencies on the standard library.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Designed for production deployments with minimal performance and maintenance cost. Easy to integrate into diverse environments.

product_brief: Rust implementation of post-quantum cryptography algorithms with no_std support.
pqc_capability_description: Validated Rust implementation supporting LMS (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer), ML-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer), ML-KEM (EncapDecap, KeyGen), and SLH-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer). Includes SHA2 and SHA3 primitives. Validated on Raspberry Pi OS (Debian 12) in ARM Cortex-A76.
crypto_primitives: LMS, ML-DSA, ML-KEM, SLH-DSA, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512, SHAKE-128, SHAKE-256
primary_platforms: Raspberry Pi OS (Debian 12) in ARM Cortex-A76
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Validated on ARM Cortex-A76; supports no_std
